alternatives.argument: The local proof forms the Bayes reverse kernel from p and q, proves normalization and composition from the forward marginal and Chapman–Kolmogorov identities, differentiates the density adjoint on compact tests, expands the product rule, and derives the compact-test martingale identity by the finite-time semigroup integral formula.

The local proof applies the kernel/generator lemma, localizes coordinate and coordinate-product tests, uses the proved continuous-local-martingale product formula to identify [M]=integral a, constructs the inverse-diffusion integral by stopped left-step sums, and applies vector Lévy under the declared AC hypothesis. The theorem states all density, ellipticity, integration, and reverse-martingale well-posedness assumptions explicitly.
